name: smwmusic-kingdom-of-ergrandt
title: Kingdom of Ergrandt
description:
A regal and imposing march fit for a powerful kingdom.

Named after a fantasy kingdom I came up with for a D&D campaign, composed based on a song I originally made in 1 hour using samples from Sid Meier's Civilization. I think it could fit a lot of more dangerous levels, castles being the most obvious, but also medieval overworlds.
